authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.66 describes the APPID R2004+ missing-xdictionary flag and xref-block hard-pointer role.
scope: Only the writer's always-synthesized reserved ACAD APPID receives missing=1 and a typed-null xref for AC1018+. Other source/caller APPIDs and the public encoder retain their previous behavior. AC1015 is unchanged; the new method is private and adds no object members or virtuals.
independent_evidence: LibreDWG 0.14 decodes the ODA-produced AC1018 ACAD APPID with missing=1 and xref=(5,0,0). It independently reads current production synthetic ACAD records the same way for AC1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 with a following LINE. AC1015 retains its untyped null and lacks the R2004 flag.
